data.body: ARG sweep complete: ruff --select ARG src/rebar 64 -> 21 (irreducible floor). Buckets: (1) tracked-defect residual x2 (close_precheck.py reason, txn.py force_close_reason); (2) Cluster-1 reconciler leaves normalized to **_kwargs (apply_inbound/apply_outbound, ~10 sites, now ARG-clean); (3) Cluster-2 Jira OutboundMapper Protocol params left RAW x7 (jira_datacenter/backend.py, jira_family/outbound_mapper.py) - cannot rename (mypy Protocol structural param-name match) and cannot noqa (RUF100 below); (4) keyword-/doc-pinned params left RAW x12 (authorship, xcheck x2, enrich_drain, plan_review __init__, prompts.langfuse_cfg [public reuse-surface signature], _config_sources.root, jira/backend.config, code_review/shim.reviewers, recorder x2); (5/6) safe _-renames across processors/scorers/providers/git_metrics/advisory_lock/etc. KEY FINDING (RUF100 landmine): pyproject select includes RUF (RUF100 unused-noqa ON) but NOT ARG, so a '# noqa: ARG00x' is itself an unused-noqa -> default ruff check FAILS. Rename-unsafe params must stay RAW --select ARG residuals, never noqa'd. Default 'ruff check src/rebar' CLEAN; typecheck clean.
